channel.title: Lynn Group Media - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Lynn Group Media (hoganstand.com)

item.title: Sigerson Cup final takes centre stage
item.description: UCC and UL face off in a fascinating Sigerson Cup final at Croke Park this evening.

item.title: Kerry club football championship draws take place
item.description: The draws have been made for the 2026 Kerry club football championships.

item.title: UL produce strong finish against UCC to claim maiden Sigerson Cup
item.description: University of Limerick are Sigerson Cup champions for the first time thanks to a 0-17 to 1-11 victory over UCC at Croke Park last night.

item.title: McKenna confident of NFL returning to Croker in 2027
item.description: Croke Park stadium director Peter McKenna says he's "really confident" about the NFL returning to GAA headquarters in 2027.

item.title: "It's so hard to go back-to-back"
item.description: Two-time All-Ireland winner Jamesie O'Connor feels it'll be very difficult for Tipperary to retain the Liam MacCarthy Cup this summer.

item.title: "There is a great energy with Mayo at the minute"
item.description: Former Westmeath star Dessie Dolan says Mayo are in a good place at the minute ahead of their third round Allianz Football League meeting with Donegal this weekend.

item.title: Corbett closing in on return for Rebels
item.description: Cork attacker Conor Corbett is nearing a return for the Rebels as they currently prepare for their third Allianz Football League outing against Offaly this weekend.

item.title: Blow for Donegal as Ó Baoill set for spell on sidelines
item.description: Donegal manager Jim McGuinness has been dealt a blow with the news that Daire Ó Baoill is set to be sidelined for the next couple of weeks.

item.title: Pitch of the Year award for Castlebar
item.description: Hastings Insurance MacHale Park in Mayo has been announced as the winner of the prestigious GAA Pitch of the Year award for 2025 with Chadwick's Wexford Park coming runner up.

item.title: Rose Of Tralee-turned-Dancing Queen hails camogie roots
item.description: Katelyn Cummins, Rose Of Tralee, Dancing with the Stars contestant, apprentice electrician, disability advocate and camogie player, isn't one for backing down from a challenge.
